articles.summary: Heritage Financial Corporation (Nasdaq: HFWA) (the "Company" or "Heritage") anticipates issuing its second quarter earnings release on Thursday, July 23, 2026 before the market opens. The Company has scheduled a conference call to discuss the second quarter earnings on Thursday, July 23, 2026 at 9:00 a.m. Pacific time (12:00 p.m. Eastern time). There will be a live question-and-answer session following the presentation. Participants may register for the call using the link below to receive dial-in details and their own unique PINs. It is recommended you join 10 minutes prior to the start time. Register for the call with the below link: https://registrations.events/direct/Q4I5378922 You may also access the conference call utilizing the numbers listed below: Live Conference Call (888) 500-3691 Access Code 53789 The conference call will be recorded and will be available via the link below for replay twenty-four hours a day ending August 6, 2026.
articles.title: Heritage Financial Announces Earnings Release Date and Conference Call
